next_step: Run 1k QPS POC on hosted API (600k doc index) + perf/cost report by 2026-03-10
notes: Background: Kitemark Foundry provides an enterprise knowledge base for mid-market SaaS support teams (ticket deflection + agent assist).
Index footprint: currently ~600k canonical KB docs + attachments (30GB text), expect growth to ~1.2M over 12 months.
Traffic profile: high QPS target during business hours — target 800-1,000 QPS at peak across multi-tenant customers; 95th pct P50 SLA expectation low latency.
Primary architecture ask: embeddings + dense retrieval (approx nearest-neighbor) + top-K reranking using a cross-encoder or lightweight re-ranker to improve precision on short queries.
Latency targets: P50 end-to-end <= 120ms, P95 < 300ms for single-shot query (embedding + retrieval + rerank).
Cost sensitivity: target cost per query (avg) <= $0.01 — looking for batching/caching opportunities and model/quantization suggestions.

Model preferences: open/FF models for embeddings (1536-2048 dim), prefer Redwood-curated embeddings if cost-effective; reranker can be smaller cross-encoder (distil-style) or Redwood hosted re-rank endpoint.
Routing requirements: region-aware routing (NA primary), fallbacks to lower-cost model variants when load spikes, and ability to pin premium customers to dedicated capacity later.
Security: SSO/SAML required, SOC2 report required, audit logs and retention controls important. Data residency: prefer EU for some customers — asking about hybrid routing/residency options.
Current infra: experimenting with FAISS + Redis cache for top-K; evaluating moving vector store to hosted solution to simplify ops and improve tail latency.
POC ask: Redwood hosted API benchmark vs existing stack — 600k doc index, 1k QPS sustained for 15 minutes, measure P50/P95/P99 latencies, tokens-per-query, and estimated monthly cost at scale.
Notes from 2026-02-15 call (Jordan/Priya): 'We need rerank precision to cut false positives by at least 30% — agent trust is key', they asked for sample eval on 2k queries.
Security review status: sent initial questionnaire 2026-02-20; infosec asked for SOC2 snapshot + encryption-at-rest details; legal requested DPA template redline.
Decision process: technical eval (SE team) -> procurement -> legal -> exec sponsor (Head of Support) sign-off. Procurement timeline ~4-6 weeks after successful POC.
Commercial signals: strong — willing to commit to 12mo reserved if performance and residency checks pass. Looking at $75k-$220k ARR depending on tiering/dedicated options.
Internal champion: Head of ML Ops (Lina Gutierrez) — wants turnkey hosting to avoid building vector ops in-house.
Potential upsell: Dedicated capacity for premium customers, Redwood Optimize addon for batching and cost tuning.
Open technical questions: best practices for hybrid rerank (sparse+dense), expected token-based pricing for reranker calls, available quantized embeddings models, and TTL for prefix caching.
